rows.impact: Low — either module flips with a two-line reorder
rows.question: Precedence of a domain verdict over a graph error
rows.resolution: Eligibility decides a target's OWN failure before walking its graph (a target failing its own control is `ineligible` even on a cycle); lifecycle and availability walk the graph first (a cycle is a catalogue defect and wins). Recorded as the one rule: *own-requirement verdicts that need no traversal come first; every traversal-dependent verdict yields to a graph error*
